response.justification: Strong mid-senior full-stack match with 20+ years of software experience. Currently a Staff Software Engineer with demonstrated expertise in primary technologies (TypeScript, Node.js, React, MongoDB, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS). Actively contributing to AI agent infrastructure, directly matching required skills. Key gaps are lack of explicit Nest.js, Jest/Vitest, and Playwright experience, though strong foundational TypeScript/Node.js expertise indicates rapid onboarding capability. Demonstrates software craftsmanship, customer focus, and knowledge-sharing commitment through teaching and open-source work.
strengths: Staff Engineer with 20+ years experience including multiple senior full-stack roles
Strong primary stack coverage (TypeScript, Node.js, React, MongoDB, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS)
Currently contributing to AI agent infrastructure with demonstrated emerging tech engagement
concerns: No explicit Nest.js experience despite being a primary framework requirement
Testing frameworks not mentioned (Jest, Vitest, Playwright) despite demonstrated TDD focus
